items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for go-live or security-sensitive release. Evidence: security fleet-doctor has no successful run, no findings, and no checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across 61 sites; compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown and is explicitly not certification. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS validation, data exposure, monitoring/incident readiness, and disclosure readiness therefore remain unverified. Risk severity: high for public launch, gated-product exposure, or security-sensitive deployment; medium for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain the existing private-launch and security-sensitive release gates, continue the existing consolidated security evidence matrix, and do not claim clearance, certification, or a clean bill of health. SearchWoot remains private. Ordinary bounded reversible growth may continue only within existing compliance, disclosure, consent, data-handling, and claims boundaries.

Security handoff: preserve the existing release gate. Do not deploy or admit security-sensitive work until dated evidence covers authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime/container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, incident response readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Use only authorized metadata and retained artifacts; do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions/configuration, add dependencies, or request duplicate telemetry.
